description: Sends a collection of G4 rules for sequential execution within a single driver session.

driverSession.description: The unique session ID associated with the current browser session. This ID is used to retrieve the appropriate browser driver for interacting with the session and performing automation tasks.

intent.description: The user and agent intent describing what the rules are meant to accomplish during execution.

agentIntent.description: The normalized intent produced by the agent for tool discovery, routing, or execution.

userIntent.description: The original intent as expressed by the user.

token.description: The G4 Authentication token used to authenticate the session initiation process. This is required to authorize the session creation.

rules.description: The ordered collection of G4 rules to be executed as one job, including their parameters and configuration.

items.description: The G4 rule to be executed, including its parameters and configuration.

toolName.description: The unique identifier of the tool (plugin) that defines the rule to be executed.

toolParameters.description: The parameters to be passed to the rule during execution.

toolProperties.description: Additional properties and configuration for the rule.

name: g4.SendRules

driverSession.description: The session key for the browser session from which the rules were executed.

value.description: The result of the rule collection execution, including the ordered per-rule output and the session buffer.

title: Send G4 Rules
